title: Check-before-you-file service for refund claims
scope: Keep preventative compliance without a Vati claim front door: a service, callable from the portal and by RSL's front door through WSO2, reads Lekuka and e-Tax data for a period, shows reconciliation issues and sends the taxpayer to the Online Refunds Application to file

acceptance.text: The check reads RSL-held data instead of asking the taxpayer to type it, and returns guidance only; it never files, blocks or scores
A portal page shows the result and links to RSL's Online Refunds Application to file
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Service and browser tests on synthetic taxpayers

evidence.text: vati_tax.prefiling (ADR-051) reads the taxpayer's e-Tax VAT return, Lekuka purchase invoices and ASYCUDA entries for a period through the site's RSL source; the taxpayer only picks the period. Guidance only from fixed wording (return arithmetic via the TAX-048 adapter, input VAT above RSL records, undeclared suppliers, not-checked sources); no lane, score, pass/fail or block; nothing stored. Callers: portal.api.check_before_filing (own taxpayer) and prefiling.api.check_before_filing (RSL front door via WSO2, service identity only). prefiling/test_rules.py 6 OK incl. every period of the TAX-118 synthetic taxpayers; bench test_prefiling_bench 5/5 OK (nothing stored, own records only, unavailable source incomplete, service-only front door).

Portal page /taxpayer/check (Check before you file, in the sidebar): period picker, figures RSL holds, guidance and a link to RSL's Online Refunds Application; no file/submit action. tests/frontend/prefiling.spec.ts at 1440/1024/390 px (Edge): 14 passed, 1 skipped (sidebar test at phone width): figures, guidance, RSL link href, only the period sent, no decision words, error states, keyboard, axe and reflow. Screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-129. Taxpayer and layout specs pass (two layout tests timed out only under parallel load and passed alone).

Fresh disposable site (frappe_dev.py verify): install and two migrations ok; app tests 608 OK; bench 246 tests with 2 failures: reminders/test_reminders_bench (pre-existing on main) and one truncated in the log; a full rerun on the kept site with the same code showed reminders plus bridge test_poller_mirrors_a_change_and_skips_unchanged_cases, which fails identically on main's code on that site (the poller takes the 50 oldest Jube-linked cases across accumulated test data). Frappe-free backend 608 with only the Windows path-separator failure; ruff, mypy, vue-tsc, eslint, prettier (changed files), vitest 77 OK, validate.py clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
